---
applyTo: "**/*.tscn,**/*.tres,project.godot"
---

# Godot Project Instructions

- Preserve node paths and resource references unless explicitly changing them.
- Do not move or rename scenes, resources, or assets without checking references.
- Do not edit `.godot/` generated data.
- Do not edit `project.godot` manually unless explicitly approved.
- Verify scene loading and runtime behavior after changes.
